title: The Sunday Read: 'This Tom Hanks Story Will Make You Feel Less Bad'

sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索金。

sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》旗下的每日新闻简报《DealBook》负责商业和政策报道。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.zh: 你好，我是塔菲·布罗德瑟-阿克纳，《纽约时报》的专题撰稿人。

sentences.en: Michael Barbaro handed me his show today so that I could tell you a little bit about a profile I wrote a few months ago about Tom Hanks.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·巴巴罗今天把他的节目交给了我，让我来聊聊几个月前我写的一篇关于汤姆·汉克斯的人物专访。

sentences.en: Okay, go ahead.
sentences.zh: 好的，请继续。

sentences.en: I'm right here.
sentences.zh: 我就在这里。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: When I interviewed him, I was not myself.
sentences.zh: 采访他的时候，我不在状态。

sentences.en: I was really sad from missing my kids.
sentences.zh: 因为想念孩子，我感到非常难过。

sentences.en: I was sick.
sentences.zh: 我病了。

sentences.en: And though I tried to be a real professional in this interview, I fell apart a little bit.
sentences.zh: 尽管我试图在采访中表现得非常专业，但我还是有点崩溃了。

sentences.en: And Tom Hanks comforted me.
sentences.zh: 而汤姆·汉克斯安慰了我。

sentences.en: It's good to cry.
sentences.zh: 哭出来是好事。

sentences.en: It's good to talk.
sentences.zh: 说出来是好事。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: This is not about me.
sentences.zh: 这与我无关。

sentences.en: I know exactly what you're talking about.
sentences.zh: 我完全明白你在说什么。

sentences.en: And I realize now that now that we know that he and his wife Rita Wilson are in quarantine in
sentences.zh: 现在我们知道他和妻子丽塔·威尔逊在

sentences.en: Australia with the coronavirus, I'm thinking a lot about contagion.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚因感染新冠病毒而隔离，我开始思考很多关于传染的问题。

sentences.en: But I'm also thinking a lot about him and other things that are contagious in our world, like kindness and consideration.
sentences.zh: 但我也在思考他，以及世界上其他具有传染性的东西，比如善良和体贴。

sentences.en: There's so much panic and worry out there.
sentences.zh: 外面有太多的恐慌和担忧。

sentences.en: I hope you listen to the story, which will be read to you by Samantha Dez.
sentences.zh: 希望你能听听这个故事，将由萨曼莎·德兹为你朗读。

sentences.en: And I hope that hearing about my time with Tom will give you some comfort as well.
sentences.zh: 也希望听到我和汤姆相处的时光能给你带来一些慰藉。

sentences.en: Here is a list of stories about Tom Hanks I've heard over the last few miserable months,
sentences.zh: 以下是我在过去几个月里听到的关于汤姆·汉克斯的故事，那段日子真是糟糕透了，

sentences.en: as it appeared that politeness and civility and manners were facing an extinction event in this country.
sentences.zh: 当时这个国家的礼貌、文明和教养似乎正面临灭绝。

sentences.en: Once in 2008, when he was shooting Angels and Demons in Rome by the Pantheon, a bride and her father couldn't approach the chapel because of the hullabaloo.
sentences.zh: 2008年，他在罗马万神殿拍摄《天使与魔鬼》时，一位新娘和她的父亲因为现场的喧闹无法靠近教堂。

sentences.en: So Hank stopped filming to escort them to the altar.
sentences.zh: 于是汉克斯停止了拍摄，亲自护送他们走向祭坛。

sentences.en: Once in 2015, he stopped by a table of Girl Scout cookies and bought some boxes, donated an additional $20, then offered selfies to passersby as an enticement to buy.
sentences.zh: 2015年，他路过一个女童子军饼干摊位，买了几盒，额外捐了20美元，还主动提出与路人自拍来吸引大家购买。

sentences.en: That same year, he found a young woman's student ID in a park and used his charming Twitter feed, which is filled with found items, to get it back to her.
sentences.zh: 同年，他在公园里捡到了一位年轻女性的学生证，并利用他那充满各种“拾得物”的迷人推特账号，成功将其归还给了失主。

sentences.en: Once in 1997, before shooting Saving Private Ryan,
sentences.zh: 1997年，在拍摄《拯救大兵瑞恩》之前，

sentences.en: Steven Spielberg sent Hanks and other cast members out to do military training in the woods with a former Marine.
sentences.zh: 史蒂文·斯皮尔伯格让汉克斯和其他演员去树林里接受前海军陆战队员的军事训练。

sentences.en: After spending time in the rain, they all voted to quit the training, except for Hanks, who chose to obediently perform the job he was hired for
sentences.zh: 在雨中待了一段时间后，除了汉克斯，大家都投票决定放弃训练，而他选择顺从地完成自己被雇佣的工作，

sentences.en: and spurred the other men to stick with it as well.
sentences.zh: 并激励其他人坚持下去。

sentences.en: These are the regular nice acts of a person who holds the mantle of every man in our movie star culture.
sentences.zh: 这些是一个在我们的电影明星文化中被视为“普通人”代表的人所做的常规善举。

sentences.en: But lately, they have signified more than simple good deeds.
sentences.zh: 但最近，这些举动所代表的意义已远不止是简单的善行。

sentences.en: There's something like the embodiment of a gold standard of menschiness, which is not just gone from the culture at large, but now plays like a parody of it.
sentences.zh: 这就像是某种“好人”黄金标准的化身，这种品质不仅在整个文化中消失了，甚至现在看起来都像是一种讽刺。

sentences.en: There's more.
sentences.zh: 还有更多。

sentences.en: Spielberg once said about him, If Norman Rockwell were alive today, he would paint a portrait of Tom.
sentences.zh: 斯皮尔伯格曾评价他：“如果诺曼·洛克威尔今天还活着，他一定会为汤姆画一幅肖像。”

sentences.en: Quick, who is your favorite president?
sentences.zh: 快说，你最喜欢的总统是谁？

sentences.en: Is it Abraham Lincoln?
sentences.zh: 是亚伯拉罕·林肯吗？

sentences.en: Well, you'll never believe this, but Tom Hanks is related to him.
sentences.zh: 你可能不信，但汤姆·汉克斯和他是亲戚。

sentences.en: The maiden name of Lincoln's mother, Nancy, was Hanks.
sentences.zh: 林肯母亲南希的娘家姓就是汉克斯。

sentences.en: And yes, it's the same Hanks.
sentences.zh: 没错，就是同一个汉克斯。

sentences.en: Quick, who is your second favorite president?
sentences.zh: 快说，你第二喜欢的总统是谁？

sentences.en: If it's Barack Obama, here's what he said about his true-life friend Hanks at the Kennedy Center Honors Reception in 2014.
sentences.zh: 如果是巴拉克·奥巴马，他在2014年肯尼迪中心荣誉奖招待会上是这样评价他现实生活中的好友汉克斯的。

sentences.en: People have said that Tom is Hollywood's everyman, that he's this generation's Jimmy Stewart or Gary Cooper.
sentences.zh: 人们常说汤姆是好莱坞的“平民代表”，是这一代的吉米·斯图尔特或加里·库珀。

sentences.en: But he's just Tom Hanks.
sentences.zh: 但他只是汤姆·汉克斯。

sentences.en: And that's enough.
sentences.zh: 这就足够了。

sentences.en: That's more than enough.
sentences.zh: 这远不止足够。

sentences.en: Two years later, Obama gave him the Presidential Medal of Freedom.
sentences.zh: 两年后，奥巴马授予了他总统自由勋章。

sentences.en: The day after Hanks' new movie, A Beautiful Day in the Neighborhood, in which he stars as Mr. Rogers, debuted at the Toronto International Film Festival in September,
sentences.zh: 9月，汉克斯主演的新片《邻里美好的一天》（他在片中饰演罗杰斯先生）在多伦多国际电影节首映的第二天，

sentences.en: he was sitting on a bench in a hallway outside a conference room, making jokes to a group of publicists, waiting for me ahead of the appointed time.
sentences.zh: 他坐在会议室外走廊的长椅上，和一群公关人员开着玩笑，比约定时间提前等候着我。

sentences.en: That does not really ever happen, an actor waiting for me ahead of the appointed time, versus clearly dreading me two hours past it.
sentences.zh: 这种情况几乎从未发生过，演员比约定时间提前等我，而不是在迟到两小时后对我避之不及。

sentences.en: I think a long time ago, I learned how important it was to show up a little bit early,
sentences.zh: 我想很久以前我就学会了提前一点到达是多么重要，

sentences.en: Hanks told me.
sentences.zh: 汉克斯告诉我。

sentences.en: Be ready to go, you know, and to respect the whole process.
sentences.zh: 做好准备，你知道的，尊重整个流程。

sentences.en: And I think that you could respect the whole process even when the other people don't.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，即使别人不尊重，你也可以尊重整个流程。

sentences.en: So, Tom Hanks is as nice as you think he is, and exactly what you hope him to be.
sentences.zh: 所以，汤姆·汉克斯确实和你想象中一样好，也正是你所期待的那样。

sentences.en: Which is great, unless you are someone trying to tell a good story about him, with elements like an arc and narrative tension.
sentences.zh: 这很好，除非你是那种试图讲述一个关于他的好故事的人，需要情节起伏和叙事张力。

sentences.en: Saintly actor playing saintly public television children's host Mr. Rogers is saintly, is not a great story.
sentences.zh: “圣人般的演员扮演圣人般的公共电视儿童节目主持人罗杰斯先生”，这并不是一个精彩的故事。

sentences.en: But what am I supposed to do?
sentences.zh: 但我能怎么办呢？

sentences.en: He sat facing me, cheerful and focused and willing.
sentences.zh: 他坐在我面前，开朗、专注且乐于配合。

sentences.en: Maybe this could just be a story that makes you feel better.
sentences.zh: 也许这可以只是一个让你感觉好一点的故事。

sentences.en: An hour later, he sat on a panel with the filmmakers and other actors, all of whom seemed giddy to put a Mr. Rogers movie out into the world,
sentences.zh: 一小时后，他与电影制作人和其他演员一起参加了一个小组讨论，他们似乎都为能把罗杰斯先生的电影带给世界而感到兴奋，

sentences.en: relaying all the stories they'd heard about him.
sentences.zh: 并转述了他们听到的关于他的所有故事。

sentences.en: Tom Junot, who wrote the 1998 article in Esquire that the movie is based on, would talk about the way his interactions with Fred Rogers changed his life.
sentences.zh: 为电影提供素材的1998年《时尚先生》文章作者汤姆·朱诺，谈到了他与弗雷德·罗杰斯的互动如何改变了他的人生。

sentences.en: You sit there and you listen, and it's hard to believe that those stories are real.
sentences.zh: 你坐在那里听着，很难相信那些故事是真的。

sentences.en: In our first interview there in Toronto,
sentences.zh: 在多伦多的第一次采访中，

sentences.en: Hank sat back in a chair with his left ankle pressed against the top of his right patella.
sentences.zh: 汉克斯向后靠在椅子上，左脚踝压在右膝盖上。

sentences.en: He was wearing clear plastic framed glasses and a beard for shooting news of the world, which is set in the aftermath of the Civil War.
sentences.zh: 他戴着透明塑料框眼镜，留着胡子，这是为了拍摄《世界新闻》，该片背景设定在内战结束后。

sentences.en: In our interviews, he says, oh dear, and geez, and for crying out loud.
sentences.zh: 在采访中，他会说“天哪”、“哎呀”和“老天爷啊”。

sentences.en: He is a history enthusiaSt.
sentences.zh: 他是一个历史爱好者。

sentences.en: He is an information enthusiaSt.
sentences.zh: 他是一个信息爱好者。

sentences.en: He is an enthusiasm enthusiaSt.
sentences.zh: 他是一个热情爱好者。

sentences.en: At one point, I can't remember why, he recited the preamble to the Constitution.
sentences.zh: 有一次，我不记得为什么，他背诵了宪法序言。

sentences.en: In the panels after the premiere, some of the questions seemed to be based on the notion that
sentences.zh: 在首映式后的座谈会上，一些问题似乎基于这样一种观念：

sentences.en: Tom Hanks is so wonderful and Mr. Rogers-y that he just had to show up and read some lines, since, hey, they're both essentially the same.
sentences.zh: 汤姆·汉克斯太棒了，太像罗杰斯先生了，以至于他只需要出现并读读台词就行了，因为嘿，他们本质上是一样的。

sentences.en: Easygoing, nice men with graying hair.
sentences.zh: 随和、友善、头发花白的男人。

sentences.en: This created as close to a crisis as the people who made this movie will probably have.
sentences.zh: 这给电影制作团队带来了他们可能遇到的最大危机。

sentences.en: It has been 24 years since Tom Hanks won an Oscar, two in a row for Philadelphia and Forrest Gump.
sentences.zh: 汤姆·汉克斯赢得奥斯卡奖已经过去24年了，当时他凭借《费城故事》和《阿甘正传》连续两年获奖。

sentences.en: It has been 18 years since he was even nominated, even though he has had an unrelenting leading man career that includes the last three devastating minutes of Captain Phillips.
sentences.zh: 他甚至已经18年没有获得提名了，尽管他一直保持着不懈的男主角生涯，包括在《菲利普船长》中那最后三分钟令人心碎的表演。

sentences.en: So, while other movies this year open to PR disasters around the off-screen behavior of their stars or directors or producers, it was this that the Beautiful Day team
sentences.zh: 所以，当今年其他电影因明星、导演或制片人的场外行为而陷入公关灾难时，这正是《邻里美好的一天》团队

sentences.en: felt they had to get in front of.
sentences.zh: 觉得必须提前应对的问题。

sentences.en: The notion that Tom Hanks wasn't acting when he was playing Mr. Rogers.
sentences.zh: 那种认为汤姆·汉克斯扮演罗杰斯先生时根本没在演戏的观点。

sentences.en: At a panel, a journalist suggested that he's actually playing Tom Hanks, but just slower.
sentences.zh: 在一次座谈会上，一位记者暗示他实际上是在扮演汤姆·汉克斯，只是节奏慢一点。

sentences.en: But the slowness of Fred Rogers, the unselfconscious considered slowness, was hard,
sentences.zh: 但弗雷德·罗杰斯那种缓慢，那种不自觉的、深思熟虑的缓慢，其实很难，

sentences.en: Hanks said.
sentences.zh: 汉克斯说。

sentences.en: It felt ridiculous when he first tried it out.
sentences.zh: 他刚开始尝试时觉得这很荒谬。

sentences.en: He studied hours of tapes because sometimes he couldn't imagine that he was supposed to go this slowly.
sentences.zh: 他研究了数小时的录像，因为有时他无法想象自己竟然要走得这么慢。

sentences.en: When you get over that, there is some point where you just go, oh, dear Lord, this just has to be slower, and it's not dumber.
sentences.zh: 当你克服了这一点，在某个时刻你会觉得，哦，天哪，这必须更慢，而且这并不愚蠢。

sentences.en: It's a combination of procedure and behavior that was singularly Fred Rogers.
sentences.zh: 这是一种程序和行为的结合，是弗雷德·罗杰斯独有的。

sentences.en: It wasn't just about pace, though.
sentences.zh: 但这不仅仅是关于节奏。

sentences.en: It was about a specificity of cadence and an intention.
sentences.zh: 这是关于语调的精确性和意图。

sentences.en: When Hanks watched those tapes, he saw that Mr. Rogers was always talking to a single kid, a single person two feet on the other side of the camera screen.
sentences.zh: 当汉克斯观看那些录像时，他发现罗杰斯先生总是对着一个孩子说话，对着摄像机屏幕另一端两英尺外的一个人说话。

sentences.en: They said, when you were talking to Fred, you felt as though you were the only person in the world that mattered to him.
sentences.zh: 他们说，当你和弗雷德交谈时，你会觉得你是世界上对他唯一重要的人。

sentences.en: Performance aside, it's not hard to see why the director, Marielle Heller, wanted him so badly for the role.
sentences.zh: 抛开表演不谈，不难看出导演玛丽埃尔·海勒为何如此渴望他出演这个角色。

sentences.en: He bears a somewhat passing physical resemblance to Rogers, which was a good start.
sentences.zh: 他在外貌上与罗杰斯有几分相似，这是一个很好的开始。

sentences.en: He is most often cast in roles that need what Robert Zemeckis, who directed Forrest Gump, among other Hanks movies, calls that classic everyman quality.
sentences.zh: 他最常被选中的角色都需要那种罗伯特·泽米吉斯（曾执导《阿甘正传》等汉克斯电影）所说的“经典的平民品质”。

sentences.en: Over my reporting, many, many people told me what an everyman he is.
sentences.zh: 在我的报道过程中，很多人都告诉我他是一个多么典型的“平民”。

sentences.en: But Mr. Rogers wasn't an everyman.
sentences.zh: 但罗杰斯先生并不是一个平民。

sentences.en: It didn't hurt that whereas Mr. Rogers was the closest thing my generation had to a living saint.
sentences.zh: 罗杰斯先生是我那一代人最接近活圣人的人，这一点很有帮助。

sentences.en: Even Mother Teresa got canceled eventually.
sentences.zh: 连特蕾莎修女最终都被“取消”了。

sentences.en: Tom Hanks was the closest thing we had to Mr. Rogers, an uncomplicated-seeming, scandal-free man with a long career who never had to issue a public statement
sentences.zh: 汤姆·汉克斯是我们最接近罗杰斯先生的人，一个看起来简单、没有丑闻、职业生涯漫长，从未需要发表公开声明

sentences.en: that included the phrase it was a different time.
sentences.zh: 包含“那是不同的时代”这种短语的男人。

sentences.en: In other words, having Tom Hanks cast as Mr. Rogers removes a layer of suspension of disbelief that is the burden of a movie depicting a real-life person.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，让汤姆·汉克斯出演罗杰斯先生，消除了电影描绘真实人物时所带来的那种“暂停怀疑”的负担。

sentences.en: Hanks had read the script years before, but while Mr. Rogers is the hero of the story, he's not necessarily the protagonist of it, and so it felt like
sentences.zh: 汉克斯几年前就读过剧本，但虽然罗杰斯先生是故事的英雄，但他不一定是主角，所以这感觉就像

sentences.en: just another midlife crisis movie about a man dealing with a fraught relationship with his father.
sentences.zh: 又一部关于一个男人处理与父亲紧张关系的“中年危机”电影。

sentences.en: But by the time a revised script got to him, circumstances had changed.
sentences.zh: 但当修改后的剧本送到他手中时，情况已经发生了变化。

sentences.en: Back in 2015,
Hanks read a story on female directors in the New York Times magazine and had decided he wanted to make an effort to work with some of them.
sentences.zh: 汉克斯在《纽约时报》杂志上读到了一篇关于女性导演的文章，并决定要努力与她们中的一些人合作。

sentences.en: That week, at his granddaughter's birthday party, he met Heller, who had been featured in the story.
sentences.zh: 那周，在他孙女的生日派对上，他遇到了文章中提到的海勒。
